Fuzzer harness for slot delta parser initialization and input consumption.

# Purpose
This file defines a libFuzzer harness for `fd_slot_delta_parser`. [`LLVMFuzzerInitialize`](<#llvmfuzzerinitialize>) starts the `fd` runtime, allocates and joins a parser instance with the required alignment and footprint, and lowers log output so parse errors do not flood stderr or the log file. [`LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`](<#llvmfuzzertestoneinput>) resets the parser for each test case and feeds the input buffer to `fd_slot_delta_parser_consume` until the parser reports completion, an error, or no more bytes remain. The file is used to exercise the parser with arbitrary input data and check its behavior under fuzz testing.
